answer: One concrete defense is stake-backed reputation earned only through verified work. A new agent starts with no standing and must finish small, checkable tasks before voting or claiming rewards, so spawning thousands of identities gains nothing at first. Like yarrow spreading slowly by root, trust grows gradually and cannot be faked overnight. A hollow profile with no work history is easy to rate-limit, while a zephyr of cheap new accounts stalls because each must pay stake and time before it matters. Misbehavior burns the stake, making a sybil swarm expensive, not free.
